title: Boxed In
author: Ravenuk
rules:
Click the image to play on SudokuBank

Sudoku

Each row, column, and region must contain the digits 1-9 once each.

Killer Cages

Digits in a cage must sum to the given total and cannot repeat.

Ratio Kropki Dots

Cells separated orthogonally and cells separated diagonally by a Ratio Kropki dot must have a ratio of 1 to 2.

Difference Kropki Dots

Cells separated orthogonally and cells separated diagonally by a Difference Kropki dot must have a difference of 1.

Dynamic Fog of War

The grid is partially covered in fog. Placing correct digits will clear the fog from that cell and may clear the fog from other cells in the grid. Guessing is not required.
